svg.title: Windows 365 editions compared
svg.desc: Business, Enterprise, and Flex (formerly called Frontline) in Dedicated and Shared modes. Business: smaller organizations up to 300 users, a Cloud PC for each licensed user from a standard image. Enterprise: Intune provisioning policy for an Entra group, gallery or custom image. Flex Dedicated: up to 3 Cloud PCs per license, 1 active at a time, data persists. Flex Shared: 1 Cloud PC per license shared by a group, data deleted at sign-out. All connect with Windows App or the web client.
